findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_poll_consensus · Private data: create_meeting_poll, get_poll_consensus, submit_participant_vote · Public sink: submit_participant_vote · Destructive: create_meeting_poll, get_poll_consensus, submit_participant_vote.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_poll_consensus · Private data: create_meeting_poll, get_poll_consensus, submit_participant_vote · Public sink: submit_participant_vote · Destructive: create_meeting_poll, get_poll_consensus, submit_participant_vote

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
